blurb.text: A Cretan PDO for sweet white wine, made as liqueur wine or wine from raisined grapes. It is at least 85% Assyrtiko, Athiri, Thrapsathiri and Liatiko, with up to 15% Malvasia di Candia Aromatica and Moschato Aspro.
